messages:
zara: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A
we flagged three partner/channel-influenced deals that could impact ARR this quarter. Can owners drop a one-line status + single next action so exec can triage? I'll monitor for 25m.

pete: Sales TL;DR (super terse):
- Nimbus Labs: $480k ARR, blocker = final SOC2 evidence + partner scheduling. Next action: send SOC artifact bundle + request 30m CISO sync. Owner: pete.
- ForgeAI (via partner ForgeWorks): $260k ARR, blocker = partner POC queue and unclear reseller margin. Next action: offer 48h engineering wedge + draft short reseller credit. Owner: amir/tom (tom on partner side).
- ClearHealth (renewal): $140k ARR, blocker = procurement PO + legal SLAs. Next action: supply procurement packet + one-line contract redline. Owner: claire.

amir: Partner note: ForgeWorks is overloaded and asked for a named contact + a lightweight onboarding checklist before committing POC engineers. If approved, we should provide a single onboarding engineer and the checklist.

claire: Legal/Finance: I can prep the procurement packet and a one-paragraph contract redline today. For reseller credit, legal prefers credits vs guaranteed margins. I'll draft both options.

robin: Product/Eng note: providing a 48h wedge for ForgeAI requires pulling one routing eng for ~48h which will shift a small infra milestone by ~1 sprint. If leadership wants to protect quarter bookings, we should reassign for the next sprint.

zara: Proposed immediate plan: (1) protect Nimbus (highest ARR) by pushing SOC artifacts and CISO call, (2) offer ForgeAI wedge + checklist if partner confirms priority, (3) keep ClearHealth on standard procurement path but expedite packet. Please confirm owners + ETA.

pete: Confirming I'll send Nimbus SOC bundle + CISO invite today and post the sent link here.

amir: I'll draft the onboarding checklist and coordinate ForgeWorks; can provide engineer if leadership signs off. ETA: checklist by EOD.

claire: Procurement packet + contract redline posted: https://docs.internal/procurement/clearhealth-2148203344. Please review.

calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Pipeline triage - Nimbus/ForgeAI/ClearHealth"
30m standup tomorrow 09:15 PST. Attendees: zara, pete, amir, claire, robin. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/2148203344

zara: Thanks team
two asks before the standup: (1) owners, please add a single-line probability estimate (low/med/high) next to each deal in the tracker, (2) tag me if anything looks like >$250k at risk. I'll escalate to exec if needed.

pete: Added tracker: https://docs.internal/risk/2148203344 - Nimbus marked high, ForgeAI marked med, ClearHealth low.

amir: ForgeWorks responded
they can prioritize if we provide the wedge and checklist. I'll confirm engineer by EOD.

zara: Great, we'll review tradeoffs in the standup. If anything changes before then, post updates here. :thumbsup:
